terms.title: Terms of use
defaultBody: Welcome to the Bowling website. Using the site — including browsing its content and sending inquiries or event bookings — is subject to the terms below, and browsing the site means you accept them.
## Using the site
- The site provides information about the venue, services, menu and events, and lets you contact us and book.
- Do not use the site for any unlawful purpose or in a way that could disrupt its normal operation.
- We may update the site's content and these terms from time to time without prior notice.
## Prices, bookings and events
- Prices on the site include VAT and may change. The binding price is the one given when your booking is confirmed.
- Submitting a booking or inquiry form is not a confirmed booking; it is confirmed only once our team gets back to you.
- The booking, deposit and cancellation terms of each event are listed on its booking form and are accepted when you submit it.
## Safety at the venue
- Please follow staff instructions and the safety rules posted at the venue.
- Playing on the lanes requires dedicated bowling shoes.
- Minors stay at the venue under the responsibility of their parents or an accompanying adult.
## Privacy
- Details you submit through the site's forms (such as name, phone and email) are used only to handle your inquiry or booking.
- We do not sell or share your details with third parties, except service providers needed to run the site (such as email delivery) or as required by law.
## Intellectual property
- All content on the site, including text, images, logos and design, belongs to the venue or its rights holders and may not be copied or used without prior written permission.
## Liability
- Information on the site is provided as is. We try to keep it accurate and up to date, but errors or changes may occur, for example in opening hours or the menu.
- The venue is not liable for damage caused by using the site or relying on its information, except as required by law.
## Governing law
- These terms are governed solely by Israeli law, and the competent courts of the Tel Aviv district have exclusive jurisdiction.
## Contact
Questions about these terms? Reach us at:
Email: info@bowling.co.il

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
defaultBody: Bowling — Ramat Gan branch places great importance on providing equal, accessible service to all our customers, and works to make both the website and the physical venue accessible in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law and its regulations, and the Israeli standard SI 5568 based on the WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.
## Website accessibility
- The site can be navigated using the keyboard alone.
- Hierarchical heading structure and alt text on images for screen readers.
- High color contrast and text that can be enlarged up to 200% without loss of content.
- Compatibility with common browsers and mobile devices.
## Physical venue accessibility
- Accessible parking near the venue entrance.
- Accessible entrance and passages for wheelchairs.
- Accessible restrooms.
- Our staff is happy to assist with any request or special need.
## Accessibility contact
Ran into a difficulty browsing or visiting? We'd love to hear and fix it. You can reach our accessibility coordinator:
Email: info@bowling.co.il

events.rulesNoteTip: A small line under the lists. Leave empty to hide it.
events.policyTip: The policy clauses on the event page. Remove every clause to hide the section.
events.policyItemTitleTip: Bold heading at the start of the clause (e.g. Postponing & cancelling).
events.policyItemDescriptionTip: The clause text, shown after its title.
events.policyNoteTip: A small line under the clauses. Leave empty to hide it.
events.formFieldsTip: The fields a customer fills in on this event's booking form. Drag to reorder. The firstName, lastName and email fields fill the name and reply-to address of the booking email — keep their keys as they are.
events.fieldKeyTip: English identifier — starts with a letter, then letters, digits or underscores (e.g. child_count). Unique in the form. Shown as the row name in the email; use email so the customer gets a confirmation.
events.fieldTypeTip: The kind of input shown to the customer (text, number, date, dropdown…). Some types reveal extra options below.
events.fieldLabelTip: Label shown above this field on the booking form (e.g. Number of children).
events.fieldPlaceholderTip: Faint example text inside the empty field hinting at the expected input.
events.fieldMinTip: Smallest number the customer may enter. Applies to number fields only.
events.fieldMaxTip: Largest number the customer may enter. Applies to number fields only.
events.optionValueTip: Value shown in the inquiry email when this option is chosen (e.g. hall_a). English, no spaces.
events.optionLabelTip: The option text the customer sees in the dropdown.
events.fieldRequiredTip: When on, the customer must fill this field before the form can be submitted.

legal.title: Terms & accessibility
legal.description: The text of this branch's terms of use and accessibility statement pages.
legal.bodyTip: Section heading: a line starting with ## · List item: a line starting with - · A blank line separates paragraphs.
legal.defaultHint: Any language left empty (or unchanged) shows the default text. To go back to the default, clear all the text and save.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Manage locations. The rest of each location's details are edited on its Settings page.
locations.name: Name
locations.nameTip: Location name shown on the site and the branch chooser page. Same as the name in Branch settings.
locations.slugTip: Branch identifier in the site address. The site only recognizes ramat-gan and rishon, so an existing branch's identifier can't be changed.
locations.visibleTip: Off: the branch is left out of the branch chooser and switcher, and its pages return 'Page not found'. Drag to set the order branches appear on the site.

team.title: Team
team.description: Add the people who manage the site and choose which locations they can edit. They sign in with a one-time code emailed to them.
team.name: Name
team.nameTip: The team member's full name, as shown in the admin.
team.emailTip: The address the one-time sign-in code is sent to. It can't be changed after the user is created.
team.roleTip: Owners manage all locations and the team. Managers edit everything in their assigned locations; staff edit content only, not branch settings or legal pages.
team.locationsTip: Locations this user can manage. Owners always have access to every location.
team.ownerAccess: Owners can manage every location and the team.
team.deleteMessage: They lose access to the admin immediately. This can't be undone.
team.created: User created — they can sign in with their email now

error.invalid: Check the name and email and try again
error.email-taken: A user with that email already exists
error.no-locations: Pick at least one location for managers and staff
error.cannot-demote-self: You can't remove your own owner role

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
